title: Rail Canonical Deployment Manifest v1
description: Machine-readable description of the current canonical Rail deployment on a specific network. One file per network. Historical deployments are preserved as immutable snapshots in deployments/history/.

schemaVersion.description: Schema identifier. Increment the version suffix when making breaking changes to this schema.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain ID. Canonical Base Sepolia value is 84532.

referenceCommit.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA that defines the canonical release. All evidence artifacts are chain-grounded against this commit.

contracts.description: Canonical on-chain contract addresses for this deployment. Contains only current canonical contracts — no legacy or deprecated entries.

VestingContract.description: VestingContract address. This contract holds the EquityToken admin role.

governance.description: Governance infrastructure. Distinct from protocol contracts — the Safe is not a token or vesting contract but the admin authority over them.

safe.description: Gnosis Safe address that holds admin authority over VestingContract and IdentityRegistry.
